what: Interactive Hexagonal Watershed Mapping and Spatial Projection
title: Interactive Hexagonal Watershed Mapping and Spatial Projection
text: hexmap R package provides interactive tools discovering USGS HUC subwatershed boundaries using Leaflet, isolating specific geographic features (island landmasses via OpenStreetMap), mathematically projecting hexagonal substrate grid networks spatial population ethology simulations.

title: Interactive Hexagonal Watershed Mapping and Spatial Projection
code: library(hexmap) library(ggplot2)  # 1. Retrieve USGS HUC12 subwatershed boundary (restricted to Isle Royale) huc_info <- get_watershed("041800000101", feature_name = "Isle Royale")  # 2. Project hexagonal substrate overlay (cell diameter = 0.01 degrees) hex_obj <- add_watershed_hex_overlay(huc_info, hex_diameter = 0.01)  # 3. Add habitat features & landmarks hex_obj <- add_habitat_hex_overlay(hex_obj)  # 4. Visualize static autoplot ggplot2::autoplot(hex_obj)

what: Moose Habitat & Substrate Overlay Utilities — habitat
title: Moose Habitat & Substrate Overlay Utilities — habitat
text: Functions extracting geographic habitat features attract moose (inland lakes, beaver ponds, cool shaded forests, bogs/wetlands), geocoding notable sighting landmarks (Washington Creek, Ojibway Lake, Feldtmann Lake, Hidden Lake), computing habitat suitability weights hexagonal substrate grids, visualizing overlays. Retrieves key moose sighting landmarks Isle Royale (customizable spatial targets): Washington Creek Windigo, Ojibway Lake, Feldtmann Lake, Hidden Lake Tobin Harbor. Generates spatial hexagonal grid across Isle Royale island geometry using pre-computed local habitat features (`isle_royale_features.rds`), without requiring external watershed GIS service calls. Intersects habitat features (lakes, waterways, forests, bogs) sighting landmarks hexagonal substrate grid overlay, calculating habitat suitability weights per hex cell.

text: UI controls hexagonal watershed mapping module. Allows geographic feature search, HUC12 identification, feature boundary clipping, hexagon scaling. Server logic utilizing Shiny module composition calling `leafletServer("map")` directly handle interactive map discovery HUC identification. Launches interactive Shiny application combining Leaflet spatial feature identification (via `leafletApp` module composition), USGS HUC12 subwatershed boundary lookup, feature area restriction, hexagonal substrate grid overlays.

what: Watershed Boundary & Hexagonal Substrate Utilities — watershed
title: Watershed Boundary & Hexagonal Substrate Utilities — watershed
text: Retrieves watershed boundary dataset (WBD) geometry HUC12 identifiers, applies OpenStreetMap feature clipping, generates hexagonal substrate grid overlays, discovers named geographical features within subwatersheds. Projects mathematical hexagonal substrate grid overlay across extracted watershed boundary.
